title: Titanic construct: real size, forming from random points
desc: A real-size ocean liner construct to replace the Anvil mode's ship. J: "it should start from random points and circles all over and connect that way" instead of bottom up; "how accurate is the real titanic for size, use that scale".

takes.name: Seeds
takes.facts: real size, 1 block = 1 m: 269 x 28 x 53 (63 to the mast tops); forms 1-80 (4 s), holds to 110; forming 40 blocks up; 40 random points spread along the surface as patches until they meet

takes.name: Circles
takes.facts: real size, 1 block = 1 m: 269 x 28 x 53 (63 to the mast tops); forms 1-80 (4 s), holds to 110; forming 40 blocks up; 26 random centres send out rings; ring lines first, the bands between after

takes.name: Web
takes.facts: real size, 1 block = 1 m: 269 x 28 x 53 (63 to the mast tops); forms 1-80 (4 s), holds to 110; forming 40 blocks up; 34 random points throw jagged lines to their neighbours, then the plating spreads from the lines

takes.name: Mix
takes.facts: real size, 1 block = 1 m: 269 x 28 x 53 (63 to the mast tops); forms 1-80 (4 s), holds to 110; forming 40 blocks up; rings at 13 centres + a web between them

takes.name: Bottom up
takes.facts: how the Anvil builds today, for comparison only

takes.name: Sizes
takes.facts: 1:1 269 blocks, 1:2 135, 1:4 67, the Anvil's current 48-block ship, a 7 x 7 house and a 2-block player
